description: Associates a Flex Cost Allocation (FCA) policy with a network resource such as a NAT gateway, EC2 instance, or VPC peering connection.

FcaPolicyAssociationId.description: The ID of the FCA policy association.

FcaPolicyId.description: The ID of the FCA policy to associate.

NetworkResourceId.description: The ID of the network resource to associate the FCA policy with.

NetworkResourceScopeType.description: Associate by scope instead of directly. When set, NetworkResourceId is the ID of the scope (an account ID, a VPC ID, or a subnet ID) and the association covers every eligible network resource in that scope; when omitted, NetworkResourceId is a direct network resource (for example a NAT gateway or instance) and must match the policy's NetworkResourceType.

OwnerAccount.description: The AWS account ID that owns the FCA policy association.

AssociatedAt.description: The timestamp when the association was created.

ExpectedEffectiveAt.description: The timestamp when the association is expected to take effect.

ManagedBy.description: Who manages the association: the account that created it, or a declarative policy.
